name: Developer Keynote
designSoul: Make complex machinery feel legible, intentional, and ready to inspect.

typography: monospace reserved for real code and state
layoutAffinities: code windows with generous line spacing
decorationDNA: fine rules, measured grids, tiny diagnostic labels
assetTreatment: use diagrams and product captures as evidence, not wallpaper
codeTreatment: selectable syntax text, short executable fragments, visible ownership and cleanup

motion.signatureMove: A claim settles first, then connected evidence resolves in reading order.
motion.interruption: Navigation stops the prior owned performance before the next slide starts.
motion.cleanup: Settled slides report zero controllers, timers, frames, and observers.
motion.reducedEndpoint: Claim and evidence appear together with hierarchy preserved and no spatial travel.

landscape: keep code and labels within one scan path
portrait: place proof in a centered lower region
convert architecture to a labeled vertical stack
stacking: keep labels adjacent to their subject
focalPoint: move the proof focal point rather than cropping it
keep code centered in its reading region
prohibitedBehavior: shrinking code below the body minimum

required: every technical claim has source or executable evidence
qa: inspect code at full portrait size
